tips:
## Reading Academic Hebrew

Academic Hebrew has characteristic structures worth recognizing:

### Construct Chains in Titles
Academic papers chain nouns extensively:
- תקציר **המחקר** — the research abstract
- סקירת **הספרות** — the literature review
- כלי **המחקר** — the research instruments
- רמת **ההשכלה** — the level of education

### Passive Constructions
Academic writing favors passives across all binyanim:
- ההשערה **נבדקה** (Nif'al) — the hypothesis was tested
- המחקר **בוצע** (Pu'al) — the study was carried out
- המודל **הותאם** (Huf'al) — the model was adapted
- התיאוריה **פותחה** (Pu'al) — the theory was developed

### Key Academic Phrases
- עולה בקנה אחד עם — is consistent with
- מצביע על — points to / indicates
- בהתאם ל — in accordance with
- על בסיס — on the basis of

### Adjective Agreement in Technical Terms
Note how adjectives agree with their nouns:
- מדגם **מייצג** (m.) — representative sample
- דגימה **אקראית** (f.) — random sampling
- ניסוי **מבוקר** (m.) — controlled experiment
